hostStatePolicy: structural-only empty directory (no tsnet state, marker, or credential); pre-staged and protected by prepare-acl.ps1 -Apply; removed by rollback when created

recoveryPolicy.configureMechanism: ChangeServiceConfig2(SERVICE_CONFIG_FAILURE_ACTIONS / SERVICE_CONFIG_FAILURE_ACTIONS_FLAG); sc.exe failure accepts only run|restart|reboot and cannot materialize the required terminal SC_ACTION_NONE, and the SCM repeats the last action beyond the configured array, so the explicit terminal none action is required for a bounded policy

serviceHost.serviceModeSelection: explicit --service argument in the registered ImagePath; production startup never depends on svc.IsWindowsService()
serviceHost.readyBoundary: Running is published only after GO_TLS_INGRESS_READY: local listener up, public route confirmed inactive (Foreground-aware), sanitized status written

publicRoute.inactivityCheck: inactivity covers top-level AllowFunnel/TCP[443], any funnel entry, and the Foreground serve sessions with the same predicate; startup clear/readback proves a Foreground-aware inactive verdict
